run_MDRunner_calculate: run an MD simulation on a single structure using MDRunner.calculate with a calculator and thermostat
create_MDRunner_instance: create an MDRunner instance with a calculator, thermostat, atoms, timestep, and step count for molecular dynamics
save_MDRunner_simulation_state: save the MD simulation state including atoms, thermostat state, and step count to a checkpoint directory
load_MDRunner_checkpoint: load an MD simulation checkpoint to resume from a previous step with restored atoms and thermostat state
write_MDRunner_results: write MD simulation results metadata as JSON including trajectory file, log file, and elapsed time
